        preprocessVowelConstraints
      • preprocessVowelConstraints(buf: var Buffer)

Vowel-letter constraints: dotted-circle insertion inside vowel sequences that look like another vowel.

Ports harfrust ot/shaper/vowel_constraints.rs (generated from the USE script development spec). Default ignorables are transparent between listed codepoints; matched runs are marked unsafe to break in the output buffer.

../buffer, ../script, ../unicode

Procs

proc preprocessVowelConstraints(buf: var Buffer) {....raises: [Exception],
    tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Inserts dotted circles into ambiguous vowel sequences for the Indic and USE scripts, on codepoints pre-normalize. Other scripts pass through unchanged (clear + sync is identity).
